claim: Every connected complete multipartite graph \(G=K_{n_1,\ldots,n_r}\) with \(r\ge2\) is proper conflict-free \((\mathrm{degree}+2)\)-choosable. If \(r\ge3\), then \(G\) is proper conflict-free \((\mathrm{degree}+1)\)-choosable.
integrity: The theorem has a self-contained constructive proof. The packaged checker only stress-tests the construction and is not used as a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: No optimality is claimed. The proof does not settle proper conflict-free \((\mathrm{degree}+1)\)-choosability for all complete bipartite graphs, and bibliographic novelty remains subject to unindexed or differently worded prior work.
title: Two witness parts for proper conflict-free choosability of complete multipartite graphs
